title: PDR: A paired diagnosis-and-repair framework for 8-bit object detectors under image corruption: Reproducibility Package
description:
Reproducibility package accompanying the manuscript PDR: A paired diagnosis-and-repair framework for 8-bit object detectors under image corruption, prepared for Knowledge-Based Systems.

The release contains analysis, pipeline, and validation code; frozen configurations and manifests; compact deterministic evidence ledgers; generated tables and figures; and the manuscript and supplementary sources. Version 3.0.5 reframes the manuscript as the PDR method (paired diagnosis, region and operand localization, selective-precision repair, verification), adds Algorithm 1, a generated comparison of selective precision with five calibration-only repairs, deployment decision rules, numbered citations, and an updated reference list. The experimental evidence is unchanged from v3.0.4, which corrected the KITTI holdout provenance and added a retrained-checkpoint holdout, a drive-clustered KITTI bootstrap, a covariance-aware heterogeneity test, and a scripted max-calibration patch. Raw benchmark datasets, trained checkpoints, TensorRT engines, ONNX graphs, and raw predictions are not redistributed; their provenance and regeneration steps are documented in the package.
